message.content:
The Battle of Waterloo (18 June 1815) was one of the bloodiest single engagements of the Napoleonic Wars.  Roughly:

| Side | Killed + Wounded + Missing |
|------|-----------------------------|
| **Allied (British, Dutch‑German, Prussian)** | ~23 000 |
| **French** | ~25 000 |
| **Total** | ~48 000 |

These figures are rounded estimates drawn from contemporary reports and modern scholarship.  The Allied forces suffered slightly fewer casualties than the French, but both sides endured heavy losses in a single day of fighting.
